title: Modulo square roots usually keep two signs
summary: For an odd prime p, a nonzero quadratic residue a has exactly two square roots modulo p, which are negatives of each other.
applies: Integer modulo arithmetic; modulus greater than 1
detail: Modulo 7, the square root of 2 is 3 and 4. Saving only one representative value given by the library function loses another candidate.
boundary: When a≡0, there are only zero roots; the composite modulus cannot directly follow the "two roots" conclusion.
relevance: When restoring the square transformation, determine whether the result is unique.
